request.style: English, gravelly male solo voice, acoustic guitar, upright bass, muted trumpet, slow blues, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron
Bring the swelling, rash, or bright spot to the priest
The hair has turned white, the sore is deep
He examines the skin, declares him unclean

[Verse]
If it looks shallow, the hair is not white
Isolate the person for seven days
Check again on the seventh day
If it has faded, he is clean

[Chorus]
Wear torn clothes, let the hair hang down
Cover the upper lip, stand alone
Cry out loud, "Unclean! Unclean!"
Live outside the camp, in the dust and the sun

[Verse]
If the disease covers head to foot
And it has all turned white, he is clean
But if raw flesh appears on the skin
The priest sees it, declares him unclean

[Chorus]
Wear torn clothes, let the hair hang down
Cover the upper lip, stand alone
Cry out loud, "Unclean! Unclean!"
Live outside the camp, in the dust and the sun

[Bridge]
A boil or a burn, a spot in the flesh
The priest examines, waits for the sign
If it spreads, it is a defiling disease
If it fades, he is clean

[Outro]
Unclean! Unclean!
Live alone outside the camp
